description.value: BNA Brewing Co.'s Vernon location serves as the main production and packaging hub for the brand, pouring over 10 house-brewed beers on tap ranging from easy-drinking lagers to adventurous sours alongside a full eatery menu. The venue is unusually expansive for a craft brewery, accommodating everything from quiet dinners to functions of up to 500 guests. Upstairs, four 10-pin and three duckpin bowling lanes plus six arcade games make it a notable stop for cyclists looking for a lively post-ride experience in the Okanagan.

address.value: 1714 Kalamalka Lake Road, Vernon, BC V1T 6M4
